answer: Because the timing is recorded against the kernel challenge, the ripple audit can replay the velvet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 246 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3313 identities would post 2782 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
